violation_type.title: Documentation for Directors - Governing Body/Director Designation Form (26 TAC §744.1037(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Documentation for Directors - Governing Body/Director Designation Form
violation_type.typical_finding: During the annual monitor inspection, the newly appointed Director had not submitted a Governing Body/Director Designation form to Licensing. Licensing learned during the inspection of the new Site Director position for this location.
